map.计算数据分布的偏度（Skewness）和峰度（Kurtosis）。: Computes the skewness and kurtosis of a data distribution.
map.📖 查看「偏度与峰度使用指南」: 📖 View the "Skewness and Kurtosis User Guide"
map.偏度 g₁ = m₃ / m₂^1.5；峰度（超额）= m₄ / m₂² − 3: Skewness g₁ = m₃ / m₂^1.5; excess kurtosis = m₄ / m₂² − 3, where mₖ = Σ(xᵢ − x̄)ᵏ / n
map.用总体中心矩度量分布形态：偏度 g₁ = m₃/m₂^1.5，正值右偏（长尾在右: Distribution shape is measured with population central moments: skewness g₁ = m₃/m₂^1.5, positive for right skew (a long tail to the right) and negative for left skew; excess kurtosis = m₄/m₂² − 3, positive when the distribution is more peaked and heavy-tailed than normal and negative when flatter. mₖ is the k-th central moment divided by n. This page computes population moments for exactly 10 observations.
map.偏度>0 右偏，<0 左偏；峰度>0 比正态更尖。: Skewness above 0 means right skew and below 0 left skew; kurtosis above 0 means sharper than normal.
map.同时给出偏度（不对称）与超额峰度（尾重）。: Reports skewness (asymmetry) alongside excess kurtosis (tail weight).
map.分布形态诊断。: Diagnoses the shape of a distribution.
map.偏度≈0.8（右偏）、超额峰度≈0.5（略尖峰）：分布右拖尾、较正态稍尖。: Skewness ≈0.8 (right-skewed) with excess kurtosis ≈0.5 (slightly peaked) means the distribution trails off to the right and is a touch sharper than normal.
map.超额峰度>0 表示尾部比正态厚，极值风险更高（金融中常见）。: Excess kurtosis above 0 means the tails are heavier than normal and the extreme-value risk higher, as is common in finance.
map.超额峰度为何减 3？: Why subtract 3 to get excess kurtosis?
map.正态峰度为 3，超额峰度=峰度−3，使正态为 0，便于判\"厚尾(>0)/薄尾(: Normal kurtosis equals 3, so excess kurtosis = kurtosis − 3 puts normality at 0, making it easy to spot heavy tails (>0) or light tails (<0).
map.偏峰度能定分布？: Can skewness and kurtosis identify a distribution?
map.不能唯一确定，仅描述矩特征；需结合 QQ 图/拟合检验。: Not uniquely, since they only describe moment features; combine them with QQ plots and goodness-of-fit tests.
